title: Contract packaging playbook: tiered SSO & RBAC commitments and pricing experiments
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Purpose: define a repeatable packaging and contractual playbook for SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC, and related security questionnaire commitments so Sales and Legal can quote consistent promises and we can A/B test pricing. Scope: three packaging tiers (Developer, Secure, Enterprise), standardized contract language for SSO/RBAC SLAs and timelines, a matrix of feature-to-tier mapping, and a pricing experiment plan to measure conversion and ARR impact.
acceptance_criteria: Clear packaging matrix that maps SSO, RBAC, SCIM, audit logs, and support SLAs to three named tiers
Contract clause templates for SSO enablement timeline, RBAC feature guarantees, and security questionnaire common answers vetted by Legal and Security
Pricing experiment plan with target metrics (conversion uplift, ACV delta, churn impact) and instrumentation hooks in the sales quoting flow
Sign-off from Security and Legal on wording and acceptable liability exposure
Implementation and rollout plan with owner for integrations (SCIM, SAML IdP testing harness) and Support playbook
notes_and_updates: 2025-02-12 - Kickoff: scoped playbook and experiment hypothesis. Identified need for standard SLAs around SSO enablement (target 14 business days for Secure tier).
2025-02-18 - Eng sync: ENG-3982 to implement SCIM provisioning and SAML metadata UI is priority; estimate 6 weeks for initial work. Marked as dependency.
2025-02-24 - Legal review: initial redlines on indemnity and warranty language. Legal requested narrow scope for uptime SLAs and clear exclusions for customer-managed IdPs.
2025-03-01 - Security input: require mandatory pen test report for Enterprise tier and recommend adding KMS/HSM support as an upsell rather than a contractual commitment.

2025-03-04 - PM decision checkpoint: proceed with three-tier packaging and pricing A/B test for inbound trial-to-paid flow; finalize contract templates for Secure and Enterprise tiers and push to Sales enablement on 2025-03-15.
decision: Recommend ‘Developer / Secure / Enterprise’ tiering. Secure tier includes SAML/OIDC SSO + basic RBAC (admin/user roles), SCIM provisioning optional add-on. Enterprise tier includes guaranteed SSO onboarding SLA (14 business days), dedicated support SLA, enforced RBAC (custom roles), audit log retention guarantees, and optional private deployment discussions. Pricing experiments will price Secure at ~1.5x Developer and Enterprise at ~3x, with ramps subject to experiment results.
next_steps: Finalize contract clause wording with Legal by 2025-03-10
Create Sales playbook and quote templates for Secure and Enterprise tiers (owner: Revenue Ops) by 2025-03-15
Instrument experiment flags in signup/quote flow and track conversion and ACV (owner: Growth)
Prioritize ENG-3982 and add acceptance tests for SAML metadata upload and SCIM provisioning
Prepare security questionnaire canned answers and attach to Sales enablement materials
